g.text: INVARIANTS 9/9 PASS · every check this build can make, made and held; per-check detail in manifest.json

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #222222

g.text: Regional specificity = Small_Intestine_Terminal_Ileum TPM ÷ median across 54 GTEx tissues.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #222222

g.text: Mouse-phenotype ring: a LEAD, not a verdict. Embryonic-lethal lines drop out of adult phenotyping, which biases exactly the essential genes the safety ring flags as risky (COUNCIL M5).

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #222222

g.text: Missing is never imputed. k = how many of the 9 EXTERNAL rings have a real measurement for that gene; your own logFC and padj are not counted. It is a completeness gauge: it orders nothing and selects nothing.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #222222

g.text: The circle runs clockwise from the ring-name gap at 12 o'clock — spoke order: the order of Atlas E-GEOD-101794 g2_g1 (unchanged). Region affects exactly one ring (regional specificity).

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #222222

g.text: Pipeline: furthest phase counts only drugs indicated for a disease with mechanistic evidence linking it to THIS target. A drug that hits the target for an unrelated indication sets no phase; those genes are drawn 'not applicable', not 'low'.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #222222

g.text: Ensembl id per gene: in the click-drawer and in values.csv, deliberately NOT on the rim at any gene count — a spoke label runs radially and the id needs 155 px where there are 121 between the circle and the scale column. Symbols are ambiguous; the id is what was queried.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #222222

g.text: Ring names are inside the circle, in a 26° gap at 12 o'clock, each at its own ring's radius. The gap is FIXED — it does not shrink as genes are added — so the spokes carry the cost:

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #222222

g.text: 13 spokes at 23.85° against the 25.69° a full circle would give (-7.2%). Each ring's SCALE, range and source stay in the column beside the circle: at the inner radii the gap is too narrow for a colour bar.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #222222

g.text: • region Small_Intestine_Terminal_Ileum was inferred from the disease, not chosen — the regional-specificity ring only — every other ring is unaffected. Crohn disease most characteristically causes transmural granulomatous inflammation of the terminal ileum, the classic site examined for diagnosis and research. Chosen for 'Crohn disease' by the region chooser (remembered from 2026-10-09). Change the region in the form and re-run if this is the wrong tissue.
